records.question: How many customers are there in total?
records.pred_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_customers FROM customers
records.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers;

records.question: List the names of all product categories.
records.pred_sql: SELECT name FROM categories
records.gold_sql: SELECT name FROM categories;

records.question: How many active customers do we have?
records.pred_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_customer_count FROM customers WHERE active = 1
records.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE is_active = 1;

records.question: What is the most expensive product's unit price?
records.pred_sql: SELECT MAX(unit_price) AS max_price FROM products
records.gold_sql: SELECT MAX(unit_price) FROM products;

records.question: List all customers from the United Kingdom.
records.pred_sql: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE country = 'United Kingdom'
records.gold_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM customers WHERE country = 'UK';

records.question: How many orders have the status 'cancelled'?
records.pred_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'
records.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled';

records.question: What are the distinct order statuses?
records.pred_sql: SELECT DISTINCT status FROM orders
records.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT status FROM orders;

records.question: How many products are discontinued (not active)?
records.pred_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS discontinued_count FROM products WHERE active = 0
records.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE is_active = 0;

records.question: How many orders has each customer placed? Show customer id and the count.
records.pred_sql: SELECT c.id AS customer_id, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id
records.gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id;

records.question: What is the average rating for each product? Show product id and average rating.
records.pred_sql: SELECT product_id, AVG(rating) AS average_rating FROM reviews GROUP BY product_id
records.gold_sql: SELECT product_id, AVG(rating) AS avg_rating FROM reviews GROUP BY product_id;

records.question: List the top 5 customers by number of orders, highest first.
records.pred_sql: SELECT c.*, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 5
records.gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY order_count DESC, customer_id ASC LIMIT 5;

records.question: How many products are in each category? Show the category name and the count.
records.pred_sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, COUNT(p.id) AS product_count FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name
records.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(p.product_id) AS product_count FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name;

records.question: What is the total amount captured across all payments with status 'captured'?
records.pred_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_captured FROM payments WHERE status = 'captured'
records.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM payments WHERE status = 'captured';

records.question: List each product's name together with its supplier's name.
records.pred_sql: SELECT p.name AS product_name, s.name AS supplier_name FROM products p JOIN suppliers s ON p.supplier_id = s.id
records.gold_sql: SELECT p.name AS product_name, s.name AS supplier_name FROM products p JOIN suppliers s ON p.supplier_id = s.supplier_id;

records.question: Which warehouses hold inventory, and how many products are stored in each?
records.pred_sql: SELECT warehouse_id, COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS product_count FROM inventory GROUP BY warehouse_id
records.gold_sql: SELECT warehouse, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM inventory GROUP BY warehouse;

records.question: How many orders were placed in 2024?
records.pred_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2024'
records.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-01-01';

records.question: What is the average unit price of products per category id?
records.pred_sql: SELECT category_id, AVG(unit_price) AS avg_unit_price FROM products GROUP BY category_id
records.gold_sql: SELECT category_id, AVG(unit_price) AS avg_price FROM products GROUP BY category_id;

records.question: List products that have never been reviewed (by product id).
records.pred_sql: SELECT product_id FROM products WHERE product_id NOT IN (SELECT product_id FROM reviews)
records.gold_sql: SELECT product_id FROM products WHERE product_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM reviews);

records.question: How many distinct customers have placed at least one order?
records.pred_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS distinct_customer_count FROM orders
records.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders;

records.question: What is the total quantity sold for each product id? Show the top 10, highest first.
records.pred_sql: SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM order_items GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 10
records.gold_sql: SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS total_qty FROM order_items GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY total_qty DESC, product_id ASC LIMIT 10;

records.question: Which customers have placed more than 8 orders? Show their id and order count.
records.pred_sql: SELECT customer_id AS id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 8
records.gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 8;

records.question: What is the total revenue (quantity * unit_price * (1 - discount)) per order? Show the top 10 orders by revenue, highest first.
records.pred_sql: SELECT oi.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue FROM order_items oi GROUP BY oi.order_id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10
records.gold_sql: SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price * (1 - discount)) AS revenue FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id ORDER BY revenue DESC, order_id ASC LIMIT 10;

records.question: For each category name, what is the total quantity of its products sold?
records.pred_sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS total_quantity_sold FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY c.name
records.gold_sql: SELECT cat.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_qty FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories cat ON p.category_id = cat.category_id GROUP BY cat.category_id, cat.name;

records.question: List each sales rep (employee) and the name of their manager.
records.pred_sql: SELECT e.employee_id, e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name AS employee_name, m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS manager_name FROM employees e LEFT JOIN employees m ON e.manager_id = m.employee_id
records.gold_sql: SELECT e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name AS employee, m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS manager FROM employees e JOIN employees m ON e.manager_id = m.employee_id;

records.question: Which products have an average review rating below 2.5? Show product id and average rating.
records.pred_sql: SELECT r.product_id, AVG(r.rating) AS average_rating FROM reviews r GROUP BY r.product_id HAVING AVG(r.rating) < 2.5
records.gold_sql: SELECT product_id, AVG(rating) AS avg_rating FROM reviews GROUP BY product_id HAVING AVG(rating) < 2.5;

records.question: What is the full name and total number of orders for the single customer who has placed the most orders?
records.pred_sql: SELECT c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS full_name, cnt.total_orders FROM (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) cnt JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = cnt.customer_id WHERE cnt.total_orders = (SELECT MAX(total_orders) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id))
records.gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY order_count DESC, c.customer_id ASC LIMIT 1;

records.question: How many orders were handled by each sales rep? Include the rep's full name, only for orders that have a rep assigned.
records.pred_sql: SELECT e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name AS rep_full_name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN employees e ON o.sales_rep_id = e.id WHERE o.sales_rep_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.id
records.gold_sql: SELECT e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name AS rep, COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders_handled FROM orders o JOIN employees e ON o.employee_id = e.employee_id GROUP BY e.employee_id ORDER BY orders_handled DESC, e.employee_id ASC;

records.question: Which products are below their reorder level? Show the product name, quantity, and reorder level.
records.pred_sql: SELECT product_name, quantity, reorder_level FROM products WHERE quantity < reorder_level
records.gold_sql: SELECT p.name, i.quantity, i.reorder_level FROM inventory i JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id WHERE i.quantity < i.reorder_level;

records.question: What is the total captured payment amount per month in 2024? Show month and total, ordered by month.
records.pred_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', payment_date) AS month, SUM(amount) AS total FROM payments WHERE strftime('%Y', payment_date) = '2024' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
records.gold_sql: SELECT substr(paid_date, 1, 7) AS month, SUM(amount) AS total FROM payments WHERE status = 'captured' AND paid_date >= '2024-01-01' AND paid_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY substr(paid_date, 1, 7) ORDER BY month ASC;

records.question: List the names of customers who have never placed an order.
records.pred_sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id)
records.gold_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM customers WHERE customer_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM orders);

records.question: For each country, how many active customers are there? Order by the count descending.
records.pred_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS active_customers FROM customers WHERE active = 1 GROUP BY country ORDER BY active_customers DESC
records.gold_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS active_customers FROM customers WHERE is_active = 1 GROUP BY country ORDER BY active_customers DESC, country ASC;

records.question: What are the names of the top 3 products by total revenue across all order items?
records.pred_sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 3
records.gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) DESC, p.product_id ASC LIMIT 3;

records.question: How many payments were refunded?
records.pred_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payments WHERE refunded = 1
records.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payments WHERE status = 'refunded';

records.question: Which suppliers are based in Germany? List their names.
records.pred_sql: SELECT name FROM suppliers WHERE country = 'Germany'
records.gold_sql: SELECT name FROM suppliers WHERE country = 'Germany';

records.question: What is the average order revenue across all orders, where order revenue is the sum of quantity * unit_price * (1 - discount) of its items?
records.pred_sql: SELECT AVG(order_total) AS average_order_revenue FROM (SELECT oi.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS order_total FROM order_items oi GROUP BY oi.order_id) sub
records.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(order_revenue) FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price * (1 - discount)) AS order_revenue FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id);

records.question: How many orders are in each status? Show status and count, ordered by count descending.
records.pred_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY count DESC
records.gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY cnt DESC, status ASC;
